## Body

PR319 final round cb3c4b9 closes R319-001: every observation, including session-gone success, is checked against started plus the unscaled product drain timeout. The old after-HTTP-drain release mutant now fails at 5.011 s; never-finishing release fails at 5.028 s without a hang. Six fixture/daemon-stop tests pass before and after restoration. Measured fixture wait is now printed beside its budget. This is a sufficient ordering certificate, not necessary: an observer descheduled past five seconds can false-fail a correctly early release. C34 follow-up N319-R2-1: use a scaled outer observer watchdog only with a separate exact completion-order witness; simply scaling the ordering comparison lets late release pass. Source review of PR324 at 44e4974 keeps early control-release start and the same HTTP drain timeout, so task-split phases do not invalidate the certificate. MagicWand: preserve the wrong-order negative control and separate causal system ordering from observer scheduling.
